analysis.one_line_summary: Creator demonstrates styling straight/wavy hair into a voluminous 90s blowout using the WavyTalk thermal round brush.
analysis.full_description: A creator shares a step-by-step styling routine using the pink WavyTalk thermal round brush (Blowout Boost) set to trending music. She opens with a curiosity hook targeting straight and wavy hair types, sections her hair, highlights the curl bounce and half-head difference, demonstrates smoothing and wrapping a section while calling out ionic frizz reduction, and concludes with a full reveal of bouncy, voluminous blowout hair.

on_screen_text.text: Why havent girls with straight/wavy hair been told about this...
USES IONIC TECHNOLOGY TO KILL FRIZZ

scenes.visual: Young woman in a white t-shirt touching her styled hair in bedroom, then sectioning top hair with clips
scenes.action: Touches bangs, then sections off her crown hair

scenes.visual: Creator holding the pink thermal round brush, winking, and bouncing a curled front fringe section with her palm
scenes.action: Shows bounce of curl and winks at camera while holding brush

scenes.visual: Side-by-side comparison on creator's head: one side styled into bouncy curls, the other side straight and unstyled
scenes.action: Compares both sides using hand gestures to show difference in volume and texture

scenes.visual: Creator wrapping a strand of hair around the heated pink round brush, gliding down and twisting to create a curl
scenes.action: Brushes through section and rolls hair around barrel to curl

scenes.visual: Creator releasing top hair clip, running fingers through thick, voluminous layered blowout curls
scenes.action: Unclips hair, runs fingers through it, shakes it out, and holds up the thermal brush

scenes.visual: Creator fluffing her styled bouncy hair, smiling excitedly at camera
scenes.action: Fluffs hair with hands and sways happily to music
